items.title: Carol Bash interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2012
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I did it once with Jon Hendricks. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh what’d he say?

ctx.x: definitely supporting the president, so there’s no question there. Yeah, so I mean I think eventually he will become the president for a second term and things will get better.
I like getting political predictions on film. I did it once with Jon Hendricks.
